# Positive observations

Package ID: `SR-20000101-001-fixture-review`
Title: Synthetic static-only review fixture
Created: 2000-01-01
Status: `Complete`

Strengths are recorded with the same evidence discipline as findings so that
later changes can be checked against them. A positive observation is not
approval or acceptance.
